description: React component for displaying and managing reactions on a post, including rendering reactions, handling emoji clicks, and optionally adding new reactions.

classes.name: ReactionList
classes.description: React component for rendering a list of reactions on a post, with functionality to add reactions if permitted.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with an empty list of emoji names.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates the emojiNames state based on the reactions prop to keep track of unique emoji names.

methods.name: handleEmojiClick
methods.description: Handles the event when an emoji is clicked, toggling the reaction for the post.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of reactions and an add reaction button if allowed.
